sections.heading: Crafting
sections.body: Choose a learned recipe, select the item tier and quantity, then spend the listed materials to create the equipment. Every crafted item starts at Common rarity, while its initial Quality is rolled separately. Higher recipe mastery improves your Quality chances.

sections.heading: Potential and progression
sections.body: Starting Potential depends on the item's tier and Quality, your mastery of that recipe, and your Crafting level. The preview shows the exact possible range before you craft. Crafting items grants recipe-mastery experience; tempering grants Crafting profession experience.

sections.heading: Tempering
sections.body: Add eligible crafted equipment to the tempering queue. Each tempering action takes 10 seconds and always spends 1 Potential. Items with no Potential, items without a current base recipe, and items that have reached Legacy rarity cannot be tempered.

sections.heading: Outcomes
sections.body:
Critical — Usually improves the item's Quality by one step, increasing its stats. A rare critical instead turns it into a leveling item.
Positive — Adds 1 item XP. At 10 item XP, the item advances to the next rarity and receives a stat improvement based on its tempering profile. Positive outcomes become less likely at higher rarities.
Negative — May spend 1 additional Potential or remove 1 item XP. The chance starts at 5% for Common items and rises by 5 percentage points per rarity step.
Neutral — Has no additional effect beyond the normal Potential cost.
